title: Stop check base run links dependencies of subdirectory packages (canary fails on the pilot)
body:
Outcome: the Stop check measures failures at the base with the dependencies of a package in a subdirectory.
Why: failuresAtBase links only the root node_modules, so in a layout like packages/seo the base run fails the same way as a broken test and the broken test is ignored as pre-existing. krn adopt --canary on the seo-audit-harness pilot clone exits 1 (gate did not refuse a broken vitest test) for this reason.
Proof: krn adopt <pilot> --canary exits 0.
